units.source_text: 这一天派人送慰问书，行动比往常更加秘密。

en.t: That day he sent someone with a letter of sympathy, acting even more secretly than usual.

units.source_text: 大约是由于心中负疚之故吧。

en.t: Perhaps it was because he felt guilty in his heart.

units.source_text: 明石道人也深恐此事泄露，因此对送信使者的招待，排场并不体面，然而心中颇觉对他不起。

en.t: The Akashi monk also deeply feared that the matter would be exposed, so his reception of the messenger was not very proper or impressive, though in his heart he felt quite sorry toward him.

units.source_text: 此后源氏公子常常偷偷地来内宅和明石姬幽会。

en.t: After that, Prince Genji often came secretly to the inner residence to meet Lady Akashi in private.

units.source_text: 两处相距稍远，频频来往，自然要防爱管闲事的渔夫撞见，因此足迹不得不稍疏。

en.t: The two places were somewhat far apart, and if he came and went too often, he naturally had to guard against being seen by meddlesome fishermen, so his visits had to become a little less frequent.

units.source_text: 此时明石姬便悲叹：“果然不出我之所料！”

en.t: At such times Lady Akashi would lament sadly, "It has turned out exactly as I expected!"

units.source_text: 明石道人也怀疑源氏公子变心，他忘记了对西方极乐世界的宏愿，只管专心等候源氏公子的光临。

en.t: The Akashi monk also suspected that Prince Genji's feelings had changed; forgetting even his great vow toward the Western Paradise, he devoted himself only to waiting for Prince Genji's visits.

units.source_text: 本已看破红尘，今又堕入尘劳，实在也很可怜！

en.t: He had already seen through the vanity of the world, yet now he had fallen back into worldly cares; it was truly pitiful.
